neet_phy_u05_t07_1.working: A couple gives zero net force, so the body is in translational equilibrium. Its torque is non-zero, so it is not in rotational equilibrium.

neet_phy_u05_t07_2.working: Taking moments about the fulcrum: E × 1.2 = 600 × 0.2, so E = 120/1.2 = 100 N.

neet_phy_u05_t07_3.working: Taking moments about B: R_A × 4 = 400 × 3 + 200 × 2 = 1600, so R_A = 400 N.

neet_phy_u05_t07_4.working: A couple gives translational but not rotational equilibrium (A-IV). A suspended body at rest has its CG directly below the suspension point (B-I). A longer effort arm gives MA > 1 (C-III). Zero net force plus zero torque about one point means zero torque about every point (D-II).

neet_phy_u05_t07_5.working: A is true. B is false, since a couple is a counterexample. C is true. D is false, because a longer effort arm gives MA > 1. E is false. So the correct statements are A and C only.
